div.head: VIIa Atr 2.1
div.ab: ⁊ gan ealle út mid halidome ⁊ clipian inweardre heortan georne to Criste.
⁊ gan ealle út mid haligdome ⁊ clipian inweardre heortan georne to Criste.
And gan ealle ut mid halidome and clipian inweardre heortan georne to Criste.
Und alle ziehen hinaus mit den Reliquien und rufen aus innerstem Herzen ernstlich zu Christus.
And let all go out with the relics and call earnestly to Christ from their inmost hearts.
And all shall go out with the relics, and from their inmost heart call earnestly upon Christ.
And all are to go out with the relics and to call on Christ eagerly from their inmost hearts.
And all shall process out with the holy relics and fervently call upon Christ with their innermost hearts.
div.note: The Latin says each priest with his people is to go barefoot in procession on the three days.
